name: Moped
description: A bicycle with operable pedals and a helper motor of 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W) or less that can't go faster than 25 mph on a flat surface. An electric bicycle that fits none of the three e-bike classes but stays within those limits is a moped.

restrictions.rule: A bicycle with operable pedals and a helper motor; electric bicycles, electric miniature scooters and electric standup scooters are excluded
Its motor produces 1.5 brake horsepower (1,125 W) or less, and the statute also caps piston displacement at 50 cc without addressing electric motors separately
Can't go faster than 25 mph on a flat surface; one that can is a motor driven cycle or motorcycle
Any class of driver license is valid, so riders must be at least 16; no motorcycle endorsement needed
A peace officer must have it removed and impounded or immobilized for 20 days when its rider has never been issued a driver license or permit, or rides on a revoked one
Exempt from the motorcycle helmet, eye-protection and equipment rules of §28-964
Registered with MVD for a $5 fee and identified by a number fixed to its frame; no title needed
Must carry liability insurance meeting Arizona's minimums
Barred from rights-of-way designated for the exclusive use of bicycles
The unregistered, unlicensed motorized bicycle category of §28-2516 covers gas motors only, not electric ones
